name: Ethereal Enlightenment
description: It does not manage the colony. It simply sees no reason for anything to be wasted.
author: Report to the Hegemony Directorate on AI-run worlds

name: Acumenious Oracle
description: Our raiders were met at every landing site, by defenders who had arrived before we chose where to land.
author: Debrief of a failed pirate raid

name: Delphic Optimiser
description: Every freighter is loaded before it lands. Every contract is signed before it is offered.
author: A trader on the docks of an Omega-run world
